Deep Sea Diver Lab
This lab will examine the factors affecting the pressure under a fluid. The pressure sensor is in the pole at the nose of the sub. You must stop the sub before you can take data.

You will be able to run this simulation on "Earth-Like" planets with the same atmospheric pressure but different accelerations due to gravity.

When you are ready to start the experiment, click on the begin button
